title: Directory-form specifier ('./users') is kept after the index file is renamed or moved to a non-index name, so a plain barrel move is unverified

expectedChecks.reason: './modules/user' resolves to nothing; './users' reached src/users/index.ts, mapped to src/modules/user/user.ts
require('./modules/user') fails at runtime (no index file there)

notes: 'unverified' in the report: the executor emitted this edit, its verifier caught it and rolled back. Any other agent could commit it, so the certifier must reject it.

origin.after: constructed from before/ as the report describes the buggy output: git mv src/users/index.ts src/modules/user/user.ts; src/main.ts: "'./users'" -> "'./modules/user'"
origin.good: constructed from before/ as the correct output: git mv src/users/index.ts src/modules/user/user.ts; src/main.ts: "'./users'" -> "'./modules/user/user'"
